race_context: The district: Southeast Fountain School Corporation, based in Veedersburg, serves five townships in central, eastern and southern Fountain County. It runs Southeast Fountain Elementary School, Fountain Central Jr./Sr. High School and Southeast Fountain Virtual Academy {sef_about}{sef_board}. Superintendent Tania Grimes reported a count of 1,021 students in January 2026, up from an ADM count of 1,010 in February 2025 {sef_min_2601}{sef_min_2502}. Grimes's 2026–2028 contract is posted on the district site {sef_supt}.

The board has five members, one from each township: Kim Sowers (Millcreek, president), Jill Duncan (Richland, vice president), Josh Foxworthy (Cain, secretary), Scott Minick (Van Buren) and Lori Grubbs (Jackson) {sef_board}. The Millcreek, Richland and Van Buren seats were on the 2022 ballot, and Cain and Jackson in 2024 {fc_2022}{wci_2024}.

Seats on the 2026 ballot: three seats, each electing one member, matching the state list {fc_2022}{in_list}. Millcreek: Sowers, elected unopposed in 2022 with 1,424 votes, is not on the ballot, and Josh A Paxton is unopposed {fc_2022}{in_list}. Richland: Crystal K. Brewer won in 2022 and left the board in December 2023 {fc_2022}{sef_min_2312}. The board interviewed Mark Parks and Jill Duncan for the vacancy on Jan. 8, 2024, and Duncan was serving by February 2024 {sef_min_2401}{sef_min_2402}. She is unopposed for her first election to the seat {in_list}. Van Buren: Minick, elected unopposed in 2022 with 1,346 votes, faces Noah Reissmann {fc_2022}{in_list}.

Board changes: Tyler Bowling, elected in Jackson Township in 2024, resigned effective May 31, 2026 {wci_2024}{sef_min_2605}. The board discussed its vacant-seat procedure in June, and Lori Grubbs was welcomed as a new member in July 2026 {sef_min_2606}{sef_min_2607}.

Budget and SEA 1: 'Senate Bill 1 update' was a board discussion item in February and April 2025 {sef_min_2502}{sef_min_2504}. The board approved the 2026 budget, capital projects plan, bus replacement plan and a 2025–2027 collective bargaining agreement on Oct. 9, 2025 {sef_min_2510}. In June 2026 it directed Financial Institutions Tax and Commercial Vehicle Excise Tax receipts to the operations fund and approved a $30-per-student education materials fee for 2026–27 {sef_min_2606}.

Teacher pay: a district notice posted in July 2026 says state employment-relations board data show the minimum full-time teacher salary was $43,000 in 2025–26 and that 'the minimum teacher salary requirement was not met for the 2025-2026 fiscal year' {sef_notice}.

Facilities: in 2024–2026 the district drew on a general obligation bond for a pool renovation and HVAC and flooring work at both buildings {sef_min_2411}{sef_min_2504}. The pool was reported operational in May 2026, with HVAC to be done by the start of 2026–27 {sef_min_2605}. The board approved a Fountain Central track renovation by Byrne & Jones Construction in March 2026, and a $98,850 change order for field-event upgrades in May {sef_min_2603}{sef_min_2605}. In March it also approved a $14,000 purchase of a Veedersburg lot for the building-trades student-built home {sef_min_2603}.

Staffing and operations: in August 2025 the board eliminated the district maintenance director position, approved state-required increases in adult meal prices and opened remaining daycare spots to families outside the district. Grimes cited board policy delegating district operations to the superintendent {wci_maint}{sef_min_2508}.

Safety and policies: in April 2026 the board approved agreements with the Fountain County Sheriff's Department for school resource officer services in 2026–27 {sef_min_2604}. In 2025–26 it adopted policies on suicide awareness, civility, whistleblower protections, artificial intelligence, electronic funds and foreign travel {sef_min_2512}{sef_min_2601}{sef_min_2603}. A revised public-records policy (Policy 209) was posted in July 2026 and discussed at the July meeting {sef_records}{sef_min_2607}.
Forums: this guide found no candidate forum, questionnaire or news coverage of the 2026 Southeast Fountain races. The only contested seat is Van Buren (Minick vs. Reissmann) {in_list}.
